entries.title: Native successful page resolve JSON response.
entries.notes: Capture the native JSON viewer for a real published homepage. Use its normal keyboard-operated pretty-print control; no HTML response wrapper. Retain actual X-Capell-Api-Version, X-Capell-Cache-Tags and ETag proof from tests/Browser/api-native-response-contract.mjs alongside the shared-runner evidence. Require real content and strong-validator304 semantics.
entries.useCase: A frontend renderer resolves a published Capell page into public JSON for rendering outside the CMS.

entries.title: Native bounded page layout JSON response.
entries.waitFor: body:has-text("Make space for your next idea")
entries.notes: Capture the native JSON viewer for the persisted studio hero section page, bounded to main. Keep the public default widget type, hero section key and real content visible without Blade component names or authoring metadata. Retain actual header/body-hash/304 proof from tests/Browser/api-native-response-contract.mjs alongside the shared-runner evidence.
entries.useCase: A frontend renderer requests the bounded layout graph for a published page.

entries.title: Page resolve forbidden JSON response.
entries.notes: Optional non-2xx runner evidence. Requires a seeded published page and a runner that treats `expectedStatus` as the successful capture status for public JSON errors. Frame the native JSON viewer at the standard width with a 120px height limit, retaining the complete one-line response.
entries.useCase: A developer verifies unsigned explicit language selection returns the documented JSON error instead of leaking context.

entries.title: Page resolve not found JSON response.
entries.notes: Optional non-2xx runner evidence. Requires a runner that treats `expectedStatus` as the successful capture status for public JSON errors. Frame the native JSON viewer at the standard width with a 120px height limit, retaining the complete one-line response.
